[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Another German translation for Ridgeside Valley, created using LLM/GPT.
Feel free to contribute at [url=https://github.com/tienducle/Ridgeside-Village-DE-Translation]https://github.com/tienducle/Ridgeside-Village-DE-Translation[/url]

[size=4][b]Install - [/b][b]Manually[/b][/size]
[size=2]From the zip file, extract the following folders into your Stardew Valley Mods folder:[/size]

[code]Stardew Valley
﻿└── Mods
﻿    ├── Ridgeside Village - German Translation
    └── Ridgeside Village
        ├── [CC] Ridgeside Village
﻿        ├── [CP] Ridgeside Village
﻿        └── Ridgeside Village
[/code]
The Ridgeside Village - German Translation folder just contains a manifest file, so that you get notified by SMAPI when a new version of the translation is available.

[size=4]﻿[b]Install - Using Installer[/b][/size]
[size=2]The installer can be found under optional files.
When running the installer, you just need to provide the path to your Ridgeside Village original mod folder.
This is just purely for convenience and does the same steps as above.
Note: The installer [b]does not automatically[/b] determine your Ridgeside Village mod folder. The default value is
"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Ridgeside Village"[/size]
